title: Study of Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, Safety of BCD-131 Compared to Mircera and Aranesp in Healthy Volunteers
brief_summary: BCD-131-1 is an Open-Label Clinical Study of the Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, Tolerability, Safety and Immunogenicity of Single Ascending Doses of BCD-131 in Healthy Volunteers
